verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS virtual-mailbox service, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a gated API, available on request, and a Zapier integration. There is no MCP server, no llms.txt and no public OpenAPI spec, and neither the API nor Zapier is credited as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
